subject.title: fix(telegram): clear generic callback buttons after click

question: Should a generic Telegram callback wait for successful button cleanup when `editMessageReplyMarkup` fails transiently, or should its value reach the agent immediately even if the old keyboard remains clickable?
rationale: Both orderings are technically coherent but trade delayed callback delivery against stale, repeatedly clickable actions; repository tests cannot determine the intended user-facing precedence.

options.title: Preserve retry-first cleanup
options.body: Keep the patch as written so transient edit failures enter callback retry handling before the payload is delivered, preventing a stale generic action from remaining usable.

options.title: Prefer immediate delivery
options.body: Route the callback value despite transient cleanup failure and treat keyboard removal as best effort, prioritizing the user's action over removal of the stale buttons.

recommendation.title: Preserve retry-first cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the patch as written so transient edit failures enter callback retry handling before the payload is delivered, preventing a stale generic action from remaining usable.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a Telegram-specific delivery-semantics decision within the subsystem ownership area.
